description: This PHP class 'TimesheetDecorator' resides in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the 'entity/Decorator' namespace. It functions as a decorator for the 'Timesheet' entity, providing methods to format start and end dates, set an employee by employee number, and retrieve the timesheet's state in a human-readable format. It utilizes traits for common helper functions and manages dependencies via reference methods.

classes.name: TimesheetDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Timesheet entity, providing methods to format dates, set employee references, and retrieve formatted state information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Timesheet object.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the timesheet.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the timesheet.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the timesheet based on an employee number.

methods.name: getTimesheetState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the timesheet as a human-readable string.
